texts.label: text
texts.orig: There are two common sensor wiring types:
texts.text: There are two common sensor wiring types:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · High-level input (PNP): This is when the CX terminal is connected to 0V and a sensor with a high-level (PNP) output signal is used. This signal is fed into the input terminal of the controller
texts.text: High-level input (PNP): This is when the CX terminal is connected to 0V and a sensor with a high-level (PNP) output signal is used. This signal is fed into the input terminal of the controller

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Low-level input (NPN): This is when the CX terminal is connected to 24V and a sensor with a low-level (NPN) output signal is used. This signal is fed into the input terminal of the controller
texts.text: Low-level input (NPN): This is when the CX terminal is connected to 24V and a sensor with a low-level (NPN) output signal is used. This signal is fed into the input terminal of the controller

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Terminals CX.0, CX.1, CX.2, and CX.3 are separate COM terminals for input signals
texts.text: Terminals CX.0, CX.1, CX.2, and CX.3 are separate COM terminals for input signals

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · All input signal voltages must be of the same type
texts.text: All input signal voltages must be of the same type

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · DO NOT connect both high-level and low-level input signals to the machine at the same time
texts.text: DO NOT connect both high-level and low-level input signals to the machine at the same time
